test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 36 men can complete a work in 36 days. They started working together. But 6 men kept on leaving the job every 7th day. In how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = 36 men × 36 days = 1296 units.

Work done in 35 days (5 intervals of 7) = 7 × (36 + 30 + 24 + 18 + 12) = 840 units.

Remaining work = 1296 − 840 = 456 units.

Days taken by last 6 men = 456 ÷ 6 = 76 days.

Total days = 35 + 76 = 111 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 111 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Men (M) = 36

Initial Days (D) = 36

Rate of leaving = 6 men every 7th day

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Men × Days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ef471cbee2852385befa17e766c33f794d09c648f5e1b77ddd62671ecd613cf.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work required = 36 × 36 = 1296 man-days.

⇒ Work done in 1st week (1-7 days) = 36 × 7 = 252 units.

⇒ Work done in 2nd week (8-14 days) = 30 × 7 = 210 units.

⇒ Work done in 3rd week (15-21 days) = 24 × 7 = 168 units.

⇒ Work done in 4th week (22-28 days) = 18 × 7 = 126 units.

⇒ Work done in 5th week (29-35 days) = 12 × 7 = 84 units.

⇒ Sum of work done until 35 days = 252 + 210 + 168 + 126 + 84 = 840 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 1296 − 840 = 456 units.

⇒ Men remaining after 35th day = 12 − 6 = 6 men.

⇒ Time taken by 6 men to complete 456 units = 456 ÷ 6 = 76 days.

⇒ Total days = 35 + 76 = 111 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 111 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Work is constant and is calculated as the product of the number of workers and the time taken (W = M × D).

Variable Efficiency

When workers leave or join, the daily work rate changes. Total work is the sum of work done in each specific interval: Σ(Mᵢ × Dᵢ).

Chain Rule

The relationship between men, days, and work is given by (M₁×D₁×H₁)/W₁ = (M₂×D₂×H₂)/W₂.</p
